ns2:section.sectionText: The Undergraduate Open Seminar in Editing and Publishing is a discovery course designed to explore the role of the copyeditor, or line editor, and developmental editor in the book publishing industry. The focus of the course will be on understanding the responsibilities of the copyeditor in the process of readying a manuscript for publication and acquiring a broadly representative set of the basic skills needed to copyedit and develop a manuscript.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to English or Rhetoric or Creative Writing major(s) or minor(s).
